post.instagram_caption:
Jensen Huang is out as Nvidia's CEO.

Nvidia's board said Huang resigned as president and CEO effective immediately and gave up his board seat. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent CEO among internal and external candidates. The stock fell more than 10% in early trading on Nov 12, and Bloomberg reports Nvidia's market value dropped below $4 trillion. It took two weeks: a spy report (NYT, Oct 29), an admitted affair (Nov 8), a WSJ report that the board was moving (Nov 11), and now a resignation. At its overnight low of $156.20, the stock was about 35% below its Oct 6 record close of $239.24.

Can a company this big be priced on one person?
